join_order.notes: Build supp_nation_flag[suppkey] = 0(none)/1(FRANCE)/2(GERMANY) direct array from s_nationkey column. suppkey is dense, use supplier_s_suppkey_lookup for mapping.
Build cust_nation_flag[custkey] = 0(none)/1(FRANCE)/2(GERMANY) direct array from c_nationkey column. custkey is dense, use customer_c_custkey_lookup.
Precompute orders_custkey[orderkey] = o_custkey via orders_o_orderkey_lookup for O(1) access during lineitem scan.

Single-pass lineitem scan. For each row: (1) check supp_nation_flag[l_suppkey]!=0 (~8% pass), (2) lookup orders_custkey[l_orderkey]→custkey→cust_nation_flag[custkey]!=0 (~8% of remainder), (3) validate pair. Early exit on supplier nation saves ~92% of order/customer lookups.

filters.notes: Applied BEFORE order/customer lookup to avoid expensive index probes

data_structures.aggregation: direct_array(double[4], indexed by (supp_nation_idx*2 + cust_nation_idx - complement) per year bucket)
data_structures.thread_local_agg: direct_array(double[4], per-thread to avoid contention, merge at end)

parallelism.notes: Parallel scan of lineitem blocks. Thread-local aggregation arrays (4 doubles each), single merge at end. Precomputed arrays are read-only shared.

indexes.notes: Skip lineitem blocks where max < 9131 or min > 9861
Map suppkey→row_id to load s_nationkey during precomputation
Map orderkey→row_id to load o_custkey during precomputation
Map custkey→row_id to load c_nationkey during precomputation

aggregation_details.layout: double[2][2][2] indexed by [supp_nation_idx][cust_nation_idx][year_idx] where year_idx = shipdate >= 9496
aggregation_details.merge: sum thread-local arrays after parallel scan

scan_optimizations.madvise: MADV_SEQUENTIAL for lineitem columns during scan
filter_order_in_scan: 1. l_shipdate range check (zonemap pre-filter + per-row check)

year_extraction.notes: Since date range is [9131,9861] spanning only 1995-1996: year_idx = (l_shipdate >= 9496) ? 1 : 0. 9496 = days_since_epoch for 1996-01-01.

resource_scoping.notes: Declare all mmap resources before RAII timer scope to exclude munmap TLB shootdown cost from timing
